# Copilot instructions

Read the [project overview](../README.md) and [contributor guidance](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
before making changes. Keep work aligned with the freezer-inventory goal and
the QR labels, meal-planning, and scratch-cooking roadmap without assuming
unsettled product or implementation details.

- Work on the requested outcome in small, reviewable changes. Avoid unrelated
  refactors and out-of-scope features.
- Add or update tests for changed behavior. Run focused tests while iterating
  and the repository checks in the contributor guidance before finishing; state
  clearly which checks were run or could not be run.
- For user-facing visual changes, verify narrow-phone and desktop layouts,
  relevant changed states, keyboard navigation, and visible focus. Include
  before/after screenshots when applicable; a new screen needs an after
  screenshot.
- Keep documentation and issue descriptions consistent with the current
  product goals. Use the [issue template](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/issue.md) to capture a
  desired outcome and acceptance criteria.
